5
Asɔrefie no dwira
1 # 1 Ah 7.51—8.11 Na wɔwiee adwuma a Salomo yɛ maa AWURADE fie no nyinaa. Na Salomo de n’agya Dawid akronkronneɛ no bae, na ɔde dwetɛ ne sika ne nnwinneɛ no nyinaa bɛsiee Nyankopɔn fie akoradeɛ no mu.
Wɔde Apam Adaka no ba Asɔrefie hɔ
(1 Ahemfo 8.1-9)
2Ɛnna Salomo boaa Israel mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo no atitire ne Israelfoɔ mu agyanom mmapɔmma no ano bɛhyiaa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔrekɔfa AWURADE apam adaka no afiri Dawid kuro a ɛne Sion no mu aba. 3#Lew 23.34 Na Israel mmarima nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano baa ɔhene nkyɛn afahyɛ a ɛwɔ nnapɔnna a ɛne bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no mu. 4Na Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa bae. Na Lewifoɔ no bɛsoaa adaka no. 5Na wɔfaa adaka no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne akronkronneɛ a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu nyinaa bae; Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no na wɔde foro baeɛ. 6Na Ɔhene Salomo ne Israel asafo a wɔbɛhyiaa ne nkyɛn adaka no anim no nyinaa kunkumm nnwan ne anantwie a wɔn dodoɔ nti wɔantumi ankan na wɔammu ano, bobɔɔ afɔdeɛ. 7Na asɔfoɔ no de AWURADE apam adaka no baa mu, de bɛsii n’afa, ɛdan no mpiakyire a ɛne kronkronkronbea no mu, kerubim no ntaban ase. 8Na kerubim no atrɛtrɛ wɔn ntaban mu, adaka no afa no so, na kerubim no kata adaka no ne ɛho mpoma no so ɔsoro. 9Na mpoma no woware ma wɔhunu mpoma no ti, adaka no ho, mpiakyire no anim, na wɔnhunu wɔ adihɔ hɔ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ da yi. 10#Heb 9.4 Biribiara nni adaka no mu gye aboɔpono mmienu a Mose de guu mu Horeb, faako a AWURADE ne Israelfoɔ pameeɛ berɛ a wɔfiri Misraim asase so reba no.
AWURADE Animuonyam no
11Na ɛbaa sɛ, asɔfoɔ no firi kronkronbea hɔ firii adie no, (na asɔfoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn no nyinaa ayɛ wɔn ho kronkron, na wɔanni nkyekyɛmu no akyi, 12#1 Be 15.19; 16.37; 25.1-7 na Lewifoɔ nnwontofoɔ no a wɔhyɛ Asaf Heman, Yedutun ne wɔn mma ne wɔn nuanom aseɛ no nyinaa hyehyɛ nwera fɛfɛ, kurakura nnawuro ne mmɛnta ne nsankutene gyinagyina afɔrebukyia no apueeɛ fam, na asɔfoɔ ɔha aduonu ka wɔn ho rehyɛne ntotorobɛnto. 13#1 Be 16.34 Na ntotorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ no yɛɛ sɛ ɔbaakofoɔ maa wɔtee ɛnne baako a wɔde reyi AWURADE ayɛ da no ase), na wɔde ntotorobɛnto ne nnawuro ne nsankuo maa nne so yii AWURADE ayɛ sɛ,
“ɔyɛ na
n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa” no,
ɛnna mununkum yɛɛ ɛdan no, AWURADE dan no ma, 14#2 Be 7.1, 3 na mununkum no nti asɔfoɔ no antumi annyina ansom, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE animuonyam ayɛ ɛdan no ma.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na wɔwiee adwuma a Salomo yɛ maa AWURADE fie no nyinaa. Na Salomo de n’agya Dawid akronkronneɛ no bae, na ɔde dwetɛ ne sika ne nnwinneɛ no nyinaa bɛsiee Nyankopɔn fie akoradeɛ no mu.


Ɛnna Salomo boaa Israel mpanimfoɔ ne mmusuakuo no atitire ne Israelfoɔ mu agyanom mmapɔmma no ano bɛhyiaa Yerusalem, sɛ wɔrekɔfa AWURADE apam adaka no afiri Dawid kuro a ɛne Sion no mu aba. Na Israel mmarima nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano baa ɔhene nkyɛn afahyɛ a ɛwɔ nnapɔnna a ɛne bosome a ɛtɔ so nson no mu. Na Israel mpanimfoɔ nyinaa bae. Na Lewifoɔ no bɛsoaa adaka no. Na wɔfaa adaka no ne ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no ne akronkronneɛ a ɛwɔ ntomadan no mu nyinaa bae; Lewifoɔ asɔfoɔ no na wɔde foro baeɛ. Na Ɔhene Salomo ne Israel asafo a wɔbɛhyiaa ne nkyɛn adaka no anim no nyinaa kunkumm nnwan ne anantwie a wɔn dodoɔ nti wɔantumi ankan na wɔammu ano, bobɔɔ afɔdeɛ. Na asɔfoɔ no de AWURADE apam adaka no baa mu, de bɛsii n’afa, ɛdan no mpiakyire a ɛne kronkronkronbea no mu, kerubim no ntaban ase. Na kerubim no atrɛtrɛ wɔn ntaban mu, adaka no afa no so, na kerubim no kata adaka no ne ɛho mpoma no so ɔsoro. Na mpoma no woware ma wɔhunu mpoma no ti, adaka no ho, mpiakyire no anim, na wɔnhunu wɔ adihɔ hɔ, na ɛwɔ hɔ de bɛsi nnɛ da yi. Biribiara nni adaka no mu gye aboɔpono mmienu a Mose de guu mu Horeb, faako a AWURADE ne Israelfoɔ pameeɛ berɛ a wɔfiri Misraim asase so reba no.

Na ɛbaa sɛ, asɔfoɔ no firi kronkronbea hɔ firii adie no, (na asɔfoɔ a wɔhunuu wɔn no nyinaa ayɛ wɔn ho kronkron, na wɔanni nkyekyɛmu no akyi, na Lewifoɔ nnwontofoɔ no a wɔhyɛ Asaf Heman, Yedutun ne wɔn mma ne wɔn nuanom aseɛ no nyinaa hyehyɛ nwera fɛfɛ, kurakura nnawuro ne mmɛnta ne nsankutene gyinagyina afɔrebukyia no apueeɛ fam, na asɔfoɔ ɔha aduonu ka wɔn ho rehyɛne ntotorobɛnto. Na ntotorobɛntohyɛnfoɔ ne nnwontofoɔ no yɛɛ sɛ ɔbaakofoɔ maa wɔtee ɛnne baako a wɔde reyi AWURADE ayɛ da no ase), na wɔde ntotorobɛnto ne nnawuro ne nsankuo maa nne so yii AWURADE ayɛ sɛ,
“ɔyɛ na
n’adɔeɛ wɔ hɔ daa” no,
ɛnna mununkum yɛɛ ɛdan no, AWURADE dan no ma, na mununkum no nti asɔfoɔ no antumi annyina ansom, ɛfiri sɛ na AWURADE animuonyam ayɛ ɛdan no ma.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
